What is https://www.homerenovationsavings.ca/without-assessment/smart-thermostat

This page is part of Ontario's Home Renovation Savings program—run jointly by Enbridge Gas and Save on Energy (the Independent Electricity System Operator)—which offers a $125 rebate on eligible smart thermostats without requiring a home energy assessment.

Key Details of the Program

  • Eligible Brands & Models: The program covers a wide range of popular smart thermostats, including:

    • ecobee (e.g., Smart Thermostat Premium, Enhanced, Essential, 3 lite)

    • Google Nest (e.g., Nest Learning Thermostat 3rd/4th gen, Nest Thermostat, Nest Thermostat E)

    • Honeywell Home (e.g., T9, T5 Gen2, X2S, X8S)

    • Copeland Sensi (e.g., Sensi Touch 2, Sensi Lite)

    • Mysa (for electric heating)

    • Sinopé

  • How to Claim the Rebate:

    • Before you buy: Request a code on the site beforehand and apply it at checkout at participating retailers (such as The Home Depot, Best Buy, or brand-specific websites).

    • After you buy: Buy an eligible thermostat from any retailer and submit your receipt online within 60 days of purchase.

  • Basic Eligibility:

    • Must be an Enbridge Gas customer using natural gas as a primary heat source, or be connected to the Ontario electricity grid and heat/cool your home electrically.

    • Must reside in a single/semi-detached home, row/townhome, or mobile home on a permanent foundation.

    • Must not have previously received a smart thermostat rebate or device through Enbridge Gas, Save on Energy, or this specific program.

Additional Bonus: Peak Perks

Once your thermostat is installed, you can also opt into the Peak Perks program, which rewards you with an initial $75 signup bonus plus $20 each subsequent year for allowing minor, scheduled temperature adjustments during peak summer electricity demand (June through September).
